Maya: Heads-up — quick design check: in the roles matrix we currently label the column "Can manage invites". PMs reported that 'manage' reads ambiguous (is it invite-only or full admin?). Thoughts? Jordan: I think we should be explicit. Suggestion: 'Invite & manage seats' — says intent and scope. Sam: +1 to explicit copy. Short and clear. Priya: Accessibility nit: long column headers truncate on narrow screens and lose meaning. If we change copy, also ensure tooltip or accessible description exists. Maya: Agreed. Tooltip that lists the exact permissions (create invites, revoke invites, assign seats) might work. For mobile we collapse to a summary row with a modal for details. Alec: From engineering: collapse + modal is doable. If we add tooltips, they must be focusable and expose aria-describedby. Also watch for keyboard focus order when row actions are present. Priya: Yes — tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers. Use role="tooltip" and manage aria-hidden properly. Maya: Another related request — audit navigation. Right now clicking a role cell opens member details. PM wants a quick "view audit" affordance inline. Any concerns about adding an extra action in the cell? Jordan: I like an inline 'View audit' action but we should avoid clutter. Maybe show on hover and when focused via keyboard as a persistent action button. Sam: Implementation note: hover-only is inaccessible. We should render the action visually hidden until focus/hover but ensure it's present in DOM and reachable via tab. Proposed pattern: persistent actions button with collapsed styles. Sam: Quick code sketch for the table cell: ``` Admin
View audit trail
``` Maya: That looks good. For copy: should the action read "View audit trail" or "Audit log"? Which is clearer? Priya: "View audit trail" reads as an action and is slightly more descriptive for screen readers. Also check i18n length. Jordan: UX: when org owners toggle SSO enforcement in org settings, we should surface downstream effects (seat reassignments, disabled invites). Add a contextual banner with a short explanation and a "simulate impact" link. Alec: Backend: we can provide a simulation endpoint that returns estimated affected seats and conflicts. That can populate the banner. API stub: GET /orgs/:id/sso/simulate?enforce=true Sam: I'll open a ticket to add the endpoint and wire it into the banner. Maya: Quick accessibility follow-up: if we add inline action buttons in the table, ensure the action order is consistent across screen sizes and that the table remains navigable with aria-sort/role="table" semantics. Priya: Also run a contrast check on the banner and action icons. Low contrast is a recurring complaint. Jordan: For the design review on Friday, please bring: updated mock of the compact header + tooltip state, the inline actions visible on focus, and the audit banner with simulated payload. Maya: Can @Jordan and @Sam update the console mock and the PR respectively? Jordan: Happy to. I will push new frames by Thursday EOD. Sam: I’ll add the focusable tooltip + actions button PR and link it here when ready. DesignBot: New frame uploaded: https://figma.redwood/designs/roles-access-v2 (auto-upload) Maya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
notes: Short thread discussing copy, accessibility, and a minor backend API for audit simulation. Includes code sketch and Figma link.
